text:
Ari: Mangrove POC hit weird TTFT regressions after a short spike test this morning. p50 went from ~160ms to ~800ms intermittently.
Nina: are they on hosted or dedicated? any prefill toggles?
Ari: hosted trial. They enabled prefill to speed demo boot, used a small batch window.
ops-bot: runtime v2.13.3 rolled to us-west-2 at 08:05. No infra alerts.
Carlos: ask for the session diag: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <tok>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/diag/session/<sid>?fields=queue,kvcache,rate`
Ari: customer pasted: `queue_wait_ms=410, kvcache_hit=false, backend_ms=92, x-ratelimit-remaining=95`.
June: kvcache_hit false + high queue_wait = prefill write/read race across shards. small batch windows + concurrency cause KV thrash.
Seth: mitigation: 1) temp disable prefill to verify baseline, 2) increase prefill_batch_window_ms to 900-1200ms, 3) enable prefill_strict_sequencing for sessions.
Nina: customer asks for a credit if POC days impacted. I'll draft conditional goodwill credit if instability persists after our guided config change.
Ari: customer disabled prefill quick test -> p50 ~210ms, no 429s.
Carlos: provisional plan: controlled re-enable with `prefill_batch_window_ms:1000` TOM 09:00 PT while we monitor kvcache hit-rate and per-shard queue_wait_ms.
ops-bot: ticket #8842 updated: "Temporarily disabled prefill; p50 improved to ~210ms. Controlled re-enable scheduled."
June: include this API patch in the email: `PATCH /v1/projects/<proj>/settings {"prefill": {"enabled": true, "prefill_batch_window_ms": 1000, "prefill_strict_sequencing": false}}`
Seth: follow-ups: ["monitor kvcache hit-rate","capture per-shard queue metrics","verify x-ratelimit headers"]
Ari: joining the 09:00 PT call with the customer. will post postmortem after. :thumbsup:
